name: Glide Scroll
summary: The whole page scrolls with a soft, weighted glide that eases to a stop instead of jumping line by line.

name: Morphing Lead Card
summary: A single sample lead card stays pinned on one side and changes stage by stage — request, consent, checked, qualified, matched, delivered — while the explanation scrolls past beside it.

name: Circuit Board
summary: The section holds still while a glowing packet travels node to node along a circuit as you scroll; each node lights up with its step, and you can click any node to read it.

name: Sideways Journey
summary: Scrolling down slides six glass panels sideways across the screen, with a step bar that fills as each panel takes centre stage; on phones the panels stack and light up as they pass the middle.

name: Console Split
summary: A fixed step indicator stays on the left while console modules on the right play their own mini-scenes — a form filling in, a consent tick, checks passing, a score dial, a map pin, a delivery — each with a glowing edge when active.

pages.title: Deep Space
pages.section: How a customer becomes your lead

name: Anatomy Hotspots
summary: A large specimen lead card stays pinned while each of its fields lights up in turn as you scroll, with a numbered note explaining that part and a progress tick for each.

name: Skyline Dive
summary: The camera falls from above a night city, down past lit towers to one glowing window, into a room where a phone on the desk receives the lead — the six steps appear as cards along the way, and the lens gently breathes with your scroll speed.

name: Facet Chapters
summary: As you scroll through numbered chapters I–VI, a set of six polished black plates with engraved step icons turns to bring the current chapter forward, with a rail marking where you are.

name: Tablet Deal
summary: A stack of frosted glass tablets, each etched with a sample lead step, is dealt one by one as you scroll — finished tablets fan back in a shallow arc while the next waits in the deck.

pages.title: Oxblood "The Club"
pages.section: How a request becomes your customer

name: Continent Zoom
summary: The opening holds the screen while scrolling flies the camera from a whole continent of dots down to one city of quote requests, and finally to a single lead travelling to one business.

name: Route Legend
summary: A map-style legend stays beside the steps while a route draws itself between six stops on the map; each stop lights up and plays a small scene (typing, checks ticking, a dial filling) as you reach it.

name: Through the Letters
summary: Scrolling flies the camera through giant sculpted letters, using each opening and notch in the letterforms as a window that frames one step of the journey.

name: Pocket Sequence
summary: A long held scene where a real-looking phone turns and tilts as you scroll: a lead text arrives, opens, becomes a pipeline card, shows the return button and the lead balance, with light glinting across the glass.

pages.title: Smoke & Rosewood
pages.section: How a lead reaches you (pinned phone)

name: Scene Reel
summary: The journey plays as six film scenes in a held frame, each opening with a circular iris cut, a clapper-style slate and a running timecode as you scroll from one scene to the next.

pages.title: Premiere
pages.section: How it works, in six scenes

name: Station Tour
summary: The 3D machine stays on screen while scrolling swings the camera around it to each of six stations in turn, highlighting the one you are reading about as panes of explanation pass by.

name: Exploded Layers
summary: The hero holds while scrolling pulls a layered glass device apart into labelled slices, each step easing forward in turn, then snaps it back together.

name: Word Portal
summary: Scrolling zooms the camera into one huge word until you pass straight through its letters into the next section.

name: Card Stack
summary: Each step card slides up over the previous one, which sinks back and shrinks slightly, building a neat stack as you scroll.

name: Skew Gallery
summary: Scrolling down drives a row of 33 polished 3D industry icons sideways; the faster you scroll the more the row leans and the icons twist, springing back to face you when you stop.

name: Ghost Numerals
summary: Huge faint numerals sit behind section headings and drift at a different speed from the page, adding quiet depth.

name: Glacier Spiral
summary: The camera spirals down around a tower of ice-glass crystals in falling snow, racking focus between near and far, and threads in to one frosted window that thaws to show the request while the six steps tick past in a lens card.

name: Forest Dolly
summary: The opening holds while the camera walks forward through seven layers of paper-cut forest, past a glass specimen case, into the story.

name: Trail Draw
summary: A winding dotted trail draws itself down the page as you scroll, with a walker moving along it to six waypoint cards.

name: Specimen Board
summary: A sample lead is pinned to a board like a pressed plant; as you scroll its six leaves fan open one by one and labelled callout lines draw out to each part of the lead.

name: Terrain Descent
summary: One long held scene flies the camera down over living 3D terrain from a whole continent to one street: territories appear, your boundary draws itself in glowing ember, and a black pin erupts with a shock ring and a sample lead.

name: Strata Vent
summary: The six steps are rock layers in a cross-section; a glowing bead travels down a vent as you scroll and each layer ignites as it passes.

name: Concertina Journey
summary: Six step panels unfold left to right across a held stage while a sample lead slip travels beneath them collecting a check at each fold, then folds itself into a paper plane and lands on a 3D phone as a new alert.

name: Mercury Morph
summary: The journey holds still while the liquid bead melts into a new shape for each of the six steps, with a droplet rail you can tap to jump between them.

name: Soft Snap
summary: On desktop the page eases to rest neatly at the top of each section, and at each step, after you stop scrolling.

name: Sticky Steps
summary: The heading stays put while the steps scroll past beside it, and the step in the middle of the screen lights up.

name: Shrinking Pill
summary: A floating frosted-glass pill menu at the top that tightens into a smaller pill once you start scrolling, with a light sweep along its edge.

name: Command Palette
summary: Pressing the search button (or the keyboard shortcut) morphs the menu pill into a glowing search box where visitors type to jump to any section or industry.

name: Section Rail
summary: A slim vertical rail fixed on the left edge with section ticks that fill as you scroll through each part; it becomes a top bar on phones.

name: Elevator Floors
summary: An elevator-style header whose floor number counts down as you descend the page; the menu opens as a brushed-metal button panel, one button per floor, and pressing one flies you to that scene.

name: Magnify Dock
summary: A floating dock at the bottom of the screen whose bubble icons swell and wobble as the pointer passes over them.

name: Liquid Menu
summary: Tapping the orb makes it melt and flood into a full menu sheet, with drops that become section bubbles that swell near the pointer.

name: Orbital Menu
summary: A full-screen menu where the links circle a glowing planet on orbit rings; hovering slows the orbit and choosing a link warps you to that section through streaking stars.

name: Masthead Collapse
summary: A newspaper-style masthead with a live date line and section index that folds away into a thin bar as you scroll.

name: Broadsheet Fold
summary: The contents open like a broadsheet newspaper unfolding, its leaves swinging out to reveal the section list.

name: Watch Crown
summary: The menu button is a knurled watch crown; opening it brings up a watch-bezel dial with the sections set around its edge.

name: Ledger Book
summary: The menu opens like a leather members' ledger — the cover swings open to reveal an index of sections.

name: Compass Rose
summary: The menu is a compass rose: each section sits at a compass point (N, NE, E…) and the rose turns to point at your choice before taking you there.

name: Gallery Wall
summary: The menu opens as a full-screen gallery index on a hairline grid, with a slowly turning 3D wire sculpture for the link you point at.

name: Control Centre
summary: Pulling down a small handle at the top (or tapping it) drops a phone-style control centre with large tiles for each section and a brightness-style slider that scrubs through the page.

name: Film Strip
summary: The menu is a strip of film frames, one per section, that you can drag and fling; picking a frame cuts to that scene with a brief flash.

name: Control Dial
summary: The menu is a control panel with a big rotary dial that clicks between sections; its label flips like a departure board as you turn it.

name: Timeline Scrubber
summary: A video-editor style timeline along the bottom of the screen with chapter marks; drag the playhead to move through the page and a thumbnail preview shows where you will land.

name: Progress Hairline
summary: A fine line across the top of the screen that grows as you read down the page.

name: Sonar Dial
summary: The menu opens as a round sonar scope with a sweeping beam and ping ripples; turn the dial with arrows, the wheel or a drag to choose a section, and its depth reads out before you dive there.

name: Altimeter Tape
summary: A ruler tape scrolls beside the story like a dive instrument, with a live depth, focus distance and step counter.

name: Thumb Index
summary: Book-style thumb-index tabs run down the right edge and open a pressed-paper index page; on phones a bookmark ribbon opens it from the bottom.

name: Contour Rings
summary: The menu opens as rings of contour lines spreading out from the button, one ring per section; pointing at a ring lifts it like higher ground.

name: Scale Rail
summary: A side rail and a map scale bar track the descent from continent to street with a live distance readout.

name: Fold-Out Map
summary: The menu unfolds like a creased paper map in accordion panels; pointing at a panel deepens its crease.

name: Droplet Menu
summary: The menu button is a mercury droplet that splits into one droplet per section and merges back together when closed.

name: Mercury Gauge
summary: A thin glass tube on the right edge fills with a column of mercury as you read down the page.

name: Magnetic Pull
summary: Buttons lean toward the pointer as it comes near and spring back when it leaves, as if gently magnetised.

name: Pointer Tilt
summary: Cards and panels tilt in 3D toward the pointer, like holding a glass card up to the light.

name: Crosshair Readout
summary: The pointer becomes a fine crosshair with live coordinates beside it, like a drafting tool.

name: Torch Glow
summary: A soft glow follows the pointer around the page, lighting the frosted glass from behind like a torch.

name: Raking Light
summary: A low light follows the pointer across a surface — stone, glass or card — picking out its texture and edges.

name: Star Trail
summary: The pointer leaves a short trail of fading stars behind it as it moves.

name: Invert Lens
summary: A circle follows the pointer and inverts the colours of whatever it passes over, growing larger over links.

name: Trailing Ring
summary: A slim ring follows the pointer with a slight lag and swells around anything clickable.

name: Compass Needle
summary: The pointer is a small compass whose needle always points toward the next section down the page.

name: Border Trace
summary: On hover a line of light runs around the button's outline.

name: Gooey Button
summary: Buttons behave like liquid — on hover the surface blobs and drips before settling back.

name: Orbit Pulse
summary: Glowing buttons with a ring that pulses outward and a light that orbits the edge on hover.

name: Chrome Sheen
summary: A bright chrome reflection sweeps across the button on hover while its label briefly scrambles and resolves.

name: Chamfer Plate
summary: Cut-corner metal plates with a hairline border; on hover a polished line of light runs along the cut edge and the plate presses in slightly.

name: Double Underline
summary: Text links sit on two fine underlines that slide past each other on hover while an arrow glides forward.

name: Stone Plaque
summary: The main button is a stone plaque with a torn, deckled edge that gently breathes and lifts on hover.

name: Wax Seal
summary: Round seal buttons with words set around a slowly turning ring; on hover the ring speeds up and the seal presses in like wax.

name: Invert Bar
summary: Full-width numbered bars ("01 → …") that wipe from ink to bone on hover.

name: Ticket Stub
summary: Buttons and cards shaped like ticket stubs with notches and a perforation; on hover the stub tears slightly and the arrow slides through.

name: Clapperboard
summary: Buttons topped with a striped film clapper that snaps shut when pressed.

name: Keycap Press
summary: Buttons look like physical keyboard keys that sink and click when pressed, with optional tiny click sounds (off by default).

pages.title: APEX COMMAND · ISLAND
pages.section: ISLAND room keys and card buttons

name: Elevator Plate
summary: Brushed-metal elevator-style buttons with a lit indicator that glows when you hover or press.

name: Corner Brackets
summary: A button framed by four corner brackets that spring outward on hover, with the label in small capitals.

name: Liquid Selector
summary: Filter tabs with a liquid highlight that stretches and slides between options as you pick them.

name: Cursor Peek
summary: Hovering a row in a huge typographic list of industries brings up a small preview — its medallion and lead value — that follows the pointer.

name: Sonar Reticle
summary: The pointer becomes a small four-tick reticle that turns when it locks onto something clickable and sends out a ping when you click.

name: Ice-Drop Button
summary: Glass buttons shaped like a falling drop, rounded on three corners; on hover the frost thaws away from the pointer, a ring pings out and the label thickens.

name: Specimen Pin
summary: The pointer is a fine ring that turns into a copper pin head over links and shows a one-word hint such as "Go" or "Walk".

name: Seed Tag
summary: Main buttons are shaped like seed tags with a cut end and a punched hole, and swing gently on hover.

name: Leaf Button
summary: Secondary buttons are leaf-shaped, with two rounded opposite corners, and a vein line draws across them on hover.

name: Heat Cursor
summary: A warm dot and ring follow the pointer; the ring becomes a hexagon over clickable things and a click sends out contour ripples.

name: Fissure Slab
summary: Buttons are cut-corner slabs of dark stone with a molten crack along the bottom that spreads into a glowing lava fill on hover.

name: Crop Marks
summary: Printer's crop marks follow the pointer and snap around whatever button or link you point at.

name: Dog-Ear Button
summary: Buttons have a folded corner that peels back further on hover while the label stretches wider.

name: Mercury Bead
summary: The pointer is a small bead of mercury that stretches and turns with the speed of your movement.

name: Ampoule Button
summary: Capsule buttons with one squared corner; on hover a chrome bead floods the button outward from the pointer.

name: Card Lift
summary: Cards and rows rise slightly on hover while their icon tile tips and grows.

name: Card Sheen
summary: On hover a faint band of light sweeps across the card as it lifts.

name: Word Rise
summary: Headline words or lines rise up from behind an invisible edge one after another, sharpening as they land.

name: Letter Cascade
summary: The headline appears letter by letter, each character rising into place in a fine cascade.

name: Blur Bloom
summary: Words slowly fade in out of a soft blur, as if coming into focus.

name: Scroll Highlight
summary: A paragraph or heading starts dim and lights up word by word in step with your scrolling.

name: Code Scramble
summary: On hover a label shuffles through random characters before settling back on the real word.

name: Signal Glitch
summary: Accent words briefly split into offset colour echoes and jitter, like a signal glitch.

name: Typewriter
summary: Text types itself out character by character, as if being entered live.

name: Magnet Letters
summary: Giant chrome headline letters lean and lift toward the pointer as it moves across them.

name: Sheen Type
summary: A slow metallic sheen glides across highlighted words or the wordmark.

name: Count Up
summary: Numbers roll up from zero to their value when they come into view.

name: Split-Flap
summary: Labels flip over like a railway departure board when they change.

name: Rolling Ticker
summary: A single line rolls up to the next industry name every few seconds ("Now showing — …").

name: Rising Wordmark
summary: A giant wordmark in the footer rises into place letter by letter as you reach the bottom of the page.

name: Weight Swell
summary: Headline letters grow from thin to bold strokes as they scroll into place, and swell fatter wherever the pointer passes over them.

name: Path Lettering
summary: Step names are written along the curve of the trail itself, following every bend.

name: Soft Serif Morph
summary: Headings arrive in a crisp serif and slowly soften into rounder, quirkier letterforms as they settle.

name: Stretch Type
summary: Big headlines stretch or narrow their letters to fill the line exactly, and widen as you scroll or point at them.

name: Speed Skew
summary: Headings lean and stretch slightly with how fast you scroll, then settle back upright when you stop.

name: Chrome Tiles
summary: Industry icons sit in matte-black chrome domes with a slowly turning polished rim.

name: Glass Card Stack
summary: Three tilted frosted-glass cards float in depth — a live sample lead feed, a routing tracker and a delivery receipt — shifting with the pointer and scroll.

name: Hologram Tiles
summary: Icons drawn as holographic wireframe glass tiles: the glyph traces itself, a scan line passes over, and a prism edge glints.

name: Jelly Bubbles
summary: Iridescent jelly-like bubble icons that wobble, shimmer and gently change shape.

name: Planet Orbs
summary: Industry icons as glowing planets with a soft atmosphere and a turning orbit ring.

name: Buzzing Phone
summary: A floating phone mockup that buzzes and receives a text, an email and a pipeline alert in sequence, with glare sliding across its screen.

name: Steel Medallions
summary: Brushed-steel round medallions engraved with each industry; they flip over to show the lead value on the back.

name: Black-Chrome Monogram
summary: A polished black-chrome monogram floats in the hero, slowly turning and reflecting a studio, and leans toward the pointer.

name: Revolving Icon Ring
summary: A band of 3D industry icons with chrome bevels revolves in a ring you can drag; the icon at the front grows and shows its lead value.

name: Carved Medallion
summary: Hovering a row of the alphabetical industry register raises a carved stone medallion beside it, with light raking across the carving.

name: Dot Atlas
summary: A living map of North America made of fine dots, where quote requests rise as thin light pillars and arc to the business they reach; it shifts with the pointer and shows live coordinates.

name: Glazed Tile Wall
summary: A wall of glazed ceramic tiles, slightly uneven like handmade pottery, each pressed with an industry icon; tiles ripple, filter and lift on hover with a tooltip.

name: Ceramic Wordmark
summary: Giant sculpted letters in bone-white ceramic fill the hero, turning gently and following the pointer.

name: Wire Sculptures
summary: Each row of the numbered catalogue holds a slowly turning 3D wire sculpture of its industry icon, spinning faster when you hover the row.

name: Porcelain Tokens
summary: A wall of porcelain tokens with rosewood-inlaid icons that cascade in, wobble, and flip and spin when chosen.

name: Projector Reel
summary: A film reel turns in the hero with film running off it, while a projector beam full of drifting dust lights the headline.

name: Lead Machine
summary: A configurable 3D machine on a turntable: lead capsules ride a belt through six working stations (hopper, stamp press, scanner, scale, route switch, delivery chute), and your chosen industry part drops in on a spring.

name: Parts Drawer
summary: A drawer of trays, each holding a real 3D industry part that turns slowly and spins up when you hover it.

name: Ice Chevron
summary: A real 3D APEX chevron with polished chrome edges and an ice-glass face floats in the hero, leaning toward the pointer and leading the camera into the dive.

name: Core Samples
summary: A large specimen viewer turns the chosen industry in 3D, beside 33 core-sample rows that each hold their own small turning icon with chrome edges and an ice face.

name: Pinned Sprig
summary: A real 3D sprig of six leaves in ceramic, walnut and brushed copper, held by a copper pin inside a frosted glass case, turning gently toward the pointer.

name: Basalt Columns
summary: Industries stand on hexagonal basalt columns in a honeycomb, each topped with a 3D obsidian icon whose metal bevels catch the lava light; columns rise on hover and a specimen panel shows the details.

name: Ceramic Phone & Plane
summary: A white ceramic 3D phone shows a sample alert while a folded paper plane loops around it trailing a fine red thread.

name: Porcelain Coins
summary: Industry icons are extruded 3D shapes with porcelain faces and graphite edges that turn like coins and tilt toward the pointer.

name: Liquid Mercury
summary: One bead of liquid chrome wobbles, follows the pointer, stretches with your scroll speed, and reshapes itself for each section into a pin, a coin, a shield or an inbox tray.

name: Element Split
summary: The mercury bead splits into 33 chrome industry icons that fly into a periodic-table grid; picking a cell fills a glass readout with its value and busiest months.

name: Fanned Tiles
summary: Five large glossy icon tiles fan out in a gentle arc under the headline, angled toward the centre.

name: Aurora Drift
summary: Soft aurora light slowly drifts behind the page and shifts gently as you scroll.

name: Film Grain
summary: A faint moving film grain over the whole page that adds texture and warmth.

name: Blueprint Horizon
summary: A blueprint grid stretches to a glowing horizon on a perspective floor, and the grid speeds up and zooms as you scroll.

name: Floating Dust
summary: Fine motes of dust hang in the air at different depths and drift as you scroll or move.

name: Liquid Blobs
summary: Large soft blobs of colour slowly melt into and out of each other behind the glass.

name: Rising Bubbles
summary: Small bubbles drift up inside cards, and a gentle wave rolls along the footer.

name: Warp Starfield
summary: A deep starfield in several layers twinkles and drifts; when you scroll fast the stars streak into warp lines, with a slowly turning nebula and the odd comet.

name: Glass Slat Beams
summary: Diagonal beams of light slowly sweep through tall frosted-glass slats behind the page.

name: Garnet Glow
summary: A dark, leather-toned background with a slow drifting garnet light that the glass objects bend and refract.

name: Drifting Contours
summary: Map-style contour lines slowly drift behind the closing section.

name: Ambient Drift
summary: Very soft pools of light drift and breathe behind the content, keeping a dark page alive without distraction.

name: Sonar Rings
summary: Faint rings ripple slowly outward behind the final call to action, like a sonar pulse.

name: Dappled Light
summary: Soft sunlight dapples slowly across the cover as if through leaves, over a fine paper grain.

name: Swaying Ferns
summary: Paper-cut ferns at the edge of the trail sway gently as if in a breeze.

name: Breathing Creases
summary: Fixed paper creases run across the page and their shading breathes and drifts as you scroll, over a fine fibre grain.

name: Spotlight Pool
summary: A soft ice-white pool of light on the near-black floor follows the mercury from section to section.

name: Twinkling Sky
summary: A soft glow sits behind the hero under a scatter of tiny stars that gently twinkle.

name: Soft Rise
summary: Content gently fades up into place once as each section scrolls into view.

name: Focus Pull
summary: Sections start out of focus and pull sharp as they arrive, like a camera changing focus.

name: Scan Wipe
summary: Sections are revealed top to bottom behind a glowing scan line.

name: Liquid Reveal
summary: Panels appear through a growing liquid blob shape that spreads until the whole tile is showing.

name: Curtain Reveal
summary: Blocks of content open like a curtain drawn upward to reveal them.

name: Ink Bleed
summary: Sections arrive as if ink were bleeding outward across paper, with a ragged, organic edge.

name: Letterbox Open
summary: The page opens like a film: black bars part from the top and bottom and a title sequence plays.

name: Match Cut
summary: A large silhouette shape stays on screen and morphs into a new icon (speech bubble, tick, shield, dial, pin, phone) as you move from one section to the next.

name: Iris Cut
summary: A scene or closing title opens from a small circle outward, like an old film iris.

pages.title: APEX Camcorder Teardown
pages.section: end of the teardown: the lens iris opens onto the next section

name: Drift Away
summary: As you start scrolling, the hero copy drifts upward, fades and blurs away so the next scene can take over.

name: Hairline Draw
summary: Fine rules and grid lines draw themselves across the page as sections arrive.

name: Stamp Slam
summary: A stamp or seal thumps down onto the page at an angle, with a little overshoot, to confirm something.

name: Skyline Sketch
summary: A city skyline outline draws itself along the footer as you reach the bottom.

name: Ice Shelf
summary: A glowing ice-shelf line stretches across the screen as the dive ends, sealing it off from the sections below.

name: Fault Line
summary: Two panels split apart along a crack that draws itself and glows as the section arrives.

name: Accordion Fold
summary: Headings arrive folded into three paper panels that open flat, with real crease shading, as they scroll into view.

name: Pleat Band
summary: Between chapters a pleated paper band unfolds across the page carrying the chapter number and title.

name: Tri-Fold Brochure
summary: Pricing opens like a tri-fold brochure: the two outer leaves swing open to reveal the plans.

name: Twin Ribbon
summary: Two rows of industry chips glide in opposite directions across the page in an endless ribbon.

name: Trade Explorer
summary: Filter tabs above a grid of industry tiles; pick one and a detail panel updates with its lead value and busiest months.

name: Peak Months Strip
summary: A row of twelve month labels where the busiest months for the chosen industry light up.

name: Drum Carousel
summary: All 33 industries sit on a rotating 3D drum you can spin by dragging, with arrow buttons or the keyboard.

name: Channel Hub
summary: A hub diagram where each delivery channel — phone, email, CRM — lights up in turn with light flowing along its wire.

name: Packet Pipeline
summary: A light packet travels along a stage rail between two glass cards, while a spec card types itself and a live score gauge fills.

name: Living Bento
summary: A bento grid of glass tiles that are all alive: lead capsules rising like bubbles, a tube router, map pings and liquid vials showing busy months.

name: Liquid Masonry
summary: A filterable masonry wall of glass industry cards that reflow smoothly when you change the filter.

name: Constellation Map
summary: Industries are stars in a constellation joined by fine lines; tap a star for a popover with its details.

name: Drifting Card Rail
summary: A rail of sample lead cards that drifts on its own and can be grabbed and thrown sideways.

name: Arch Doorway
summary: Cards shaped like arched doorways with fine engraved borders that open into view.

name: Credits Roll
summary: Industries roll past like film credits under a sweeping projector beam; each has a marquee-bulb icon whose lights chase around it on hover.

name: Rewind Strip
summary: A strip of film frames — each a lead — runs backward endlessly, with bad leads marked, to illustrate sending them back.

name: Footer Ticker
summary: A slim ticker line along the footer scrolls an endless list of industries or status notes.

name: Lit Window Facade
summary: Industries are the 33 windows of a building facade that light up one by one; hover or tap a window to see its details, and windows flicker now and then.

name: Detail Drawer
summary: Choosing an industry slides out a frosted drawer with its value, busiest months and a call to action.

name: Herbarium Drawer
summary: Industries are pressed specimen plates in a staggered three-column drawer; the columns drift at different speeds as you scroll and each plate holds its own 3D icon.

name: Seed Packets
summary: Pricing plans are seed packets with a little window; on hover the packet tips forward and a seed peeks out of the top.

name: Trail's End
summary: The page ends in a forest clearing where the trail stops at a signpost beside the final call to action.

name: Ridge Line
summary: Three plans sit beneath a mountain-ridge line; the peak above the plan you point at rises and glows.

name: Creased Tiles
summary: A strict grid of creased paper tiles whose corner peels like a dog-ear on hover, with a translucent detail strip that stays in view while you browse.

name: Return Slip
summary: A sample lead slip folds back along a red return arrow into an account tray to show how returns work.

name: Mercury Vials
summary: Plans sit beside glass test-tubes whose mercury level rises when they appear and when you point at them.

name: Filter Grid
summary: Filter buttons above a grid of industry cards switch between all industries, high-ticket sectors and local trades.

name: Value Index
summary: A two-column index lists every industry with its icon and lead value range, high-ticket sectors on one side and trades on the other.

name: Sample Lead Card
summary: A frosted sample lead card with a verified chip and a value range sits beside the headline, with a small delivery card beneath it.

name: Market Table
summary: A terminal-style table beside the headline lists the top contract values by market.

name: Icon Orbit
summary: Twelve high-ticket industry icons circle a softly glowing core; pointing at one pauses the orbit and shows its name and value in the centre.

name: Lead Stream
summary: A tilted glass panel of sample leads scrolls upward endlessly like a live feed, pausing when you point at it.

name: Terminal Check
summary: The area checker looks like a terminal; submitting prints the result back line by line.

name: Live Member Card
summary: An application form that writes your details onto a tilting membership card as you type, then stamps it when you submit.

name: Pin Drop
summary: Enter an industry and postal code and a pin drops onto the 3D map with a bounce while each check ticks off in turn.

name: Exhibition Ticket
summary: The sign-up is styled as an exhibition ticket that gets stamped when you submit.

name: Receipt Printout
summary: Submitting the area form prints a receipt or ticket with a reference code, line by line.

name: Dial & Lever
summary: Physical-feeling controls — a rotary dial for territory size and a lever for monthly volume — that click into place and update the 3D machine and a live readout.

name: Underline Form
summary: A clean editorial form with underline-only inputs that light up as you fill them.

name: Launch Rings
summary: The final call to action sits inside glowing rings that slowly orbit around it like a launch pad.

name: Marquee Lights
summary: The final call to action is framed like a theatre marquee with a border of chasing lights.

name: Sonar Scope
summary: The area checker sits beside a sonar scope: a beam sweeps, blips glow, and your spot pings when you submit.

name: Contour Pin
summary: A slowly turning contour map sits behind the area checker; submitting drops a copper pin onto your spot with spreading rings.

name: Topo Survey
summary: Submitting the area checker runs a survey: contour lines form, a scan sweeps across, an ember boundary draws and a pin drops on your spot.

name: Postcard Check
summary: The area checker is a postcard: your postcode appears inside a turning postmark and the reply note unfolds beneath it.

name: Mercury Ripple
summary: Submitting the area check turns the bead into a chrome map pin with ripples spreading across the floor beneath it, then shows a sample result.

name: Pipeline Estimator
summary: Pick an industry and drag two sliders, leads per month and close rate, and an estimated monthly pipeline rolls to its new value.

name: Darkroom Light Field
summary: A slow, near-black haze of silver smoke drifts behind the page with a soft lamp under the hero that leans toward the pointer.

name: Frame Fan
summary: Four frosted picture frames fan out under the headline like a dealt hand, float gently, lift and straighten when you point at one, and fill with your latest pictures as they finish.

name: Fan Fold
summary: As you scroll down, the fanned frames fold back into a neat stack and the hero sinks into the dark, handing the stage to the results.

name: Darkroom Develop
summary: While a picture is being made its slot shimmers like silver film with a ticking timer; when it is ready it develops from a negative into the full picture with a pass of light.

name: Frame Lift
summary: Clicking a picture lifts it straight out of the grid and grows it into the full-screen viewer, then sets it back in its place when you close.

name: Studio Switch
summary: Moving between the image and video studios keeps the top bar perfectly still while the page itself softly cross-fades underneath.

name: Liquid Glass Prompt Bar
summary: A floating, see-through frosted glass bar whose rim catches a light that turns toward the pointer; its chips open small glass menus and it brightens when you start typing.

name: Liquid Gold Trigger
summary: A dark glass button with a slowly turning gold-chrome rim, a fine mesh inside and a ribbon of liquid metal; it rests in cool silver until it is ready, then wakes into gold and flashes when pressed.
bestFor: the one main action on a page

name: Chrome Iris
summary: A real 3D camera iris in polished chrome and onyx floats on the empty stage: its blades breathe, open toward your pointer, close as you scroll away and spin faster while a shot renders.

name: Iris Reveal
summary: When a finished video arrives, the iris blades open wide and the lens flies past the camera while the new video pulls into focus behind it.

name: Studio Light Field
summary: A near-black haze crossed by a slow diagonal softbox beam, with a faint light that follows the pointer and lifts a little while something is rendering.

name: Viewfinder Stage
summary: The hero is framed like a camera viewfinder: corner brackets snap into place, a live timecode runs, a record light shows when shots are rendering, and the frame refocuses each time a new shot lands.

name: Hover Reel Grid
summary: A wall of finished clips that play silently when you point at them, with a soft light following the pointer, cards that rise in column by column as you scroll, and a filter by maker.

name: Shutter Split
summary: Each headline letter rises out of the frame line one after another, coming out of a slight blur and tilt, like a shutter clicking open.

name: Glow Ring Cursor
summary: A soft glowing ring trails the pointer, swells over buttons and becomes a PLAY lens over videos, while the normal cursor stays visible.

name: Stage Hand-off
summary: Scrolling from the hero into the library lifts and blurs the headline away, lets the stage recede, opens out the viewfinder and frosts the side panel and top bar so the next section reads cleanly.

name: Lens-Edge Prompt Dock
summary: A floating glass prompt bar whose edges bend the scene behind it like thick glass, with a light that travels slowly around its rim; it frosts over once you scroll past the stage.

name: Liquid Chrome Bar
summary: A solid bar of pale gold-chrome with ribbons of liquid metal flowing through it, a highlight that follows the pointer, a sheen on hover and a soft spring when pressed.

name: Proof Rail
summary: A slim glass column lists every piece in a review with its thumbnail, version count and a status chip, and turns into a swipeable strip on phones.

name: Version Wipe
summary: Two versions of the same picture or film sit on top of each other and a glass handle wipes between them; drag it or use the arrow keys.

name: Pin Drop
summary: Tap a picture and a numbered platinum pin drops onto that exact spot with a soft spring and a ring of light, then a glass note card opens beside it.

name: Approval Seal
summary: When a piece is approved, one thin platinum line draws itself all the way around the frame and fades, and the piece is marked as locked.

name: The Develop
summary: Each new picture or clip waits behind frosted dark glass that clears as the work really progresses; at 100% one pale chrome-gold light runs once round the edge, then the glass glides into its place in the gallery.

name: Client Switcher
summary: A small platinum monogram in the top bar shows whose work you are in; open it to jump to another client or add a new one, and the page reopens as theirs.

name: Brand Lock Chip
summary: A lock chip beside the prompt shows the client's brand kit and version; tap it to lock their colours, product and looks to avoid into every request, with a simple draft-or-final switch beside it.

name: Iris Dive
summary: The page opens on a real chrome camera iris beside the headline; as you scroll the words drift away, the blades open and you dive straight through the lens into the page.

name: Exploded Screens
summary: A stack of product screens in polished frames tips back and pulls apart into numbered layers as you scroll, and each layer lifts forward in turn while a list beside it lights up.

name: Darkroom Fan
summary: Screens are dealt out into a fan like prints on a table as you scroll, each one developing from a negative into the full picture with a pass of light; point at one and it lifts out of the hand.

name: Phone Handoff
summary: A phone screen slides up and straightens in front of the desktop view as you scroll, then one platinum line seals itself around the frame to show the approval.

name: Risk Scan
summary: A soft scan line sweeps down a screen as you scroll, faintly tinting what it has checked, and a padlock snaps shut when the check finds a problem.

name: Chrome Bezel Tilt
summary: Screenshots sit in a polished platinum bezel that leans toward your pointer with a glare that follows it; click one and it opens full screen.

name: Tally Lamp Button
summary: A smoked-glass button with a camera tally lamp; pointing at it lights the lamp, a ring rolls off it like a recording light, and a chrome sheen crosses the glass.

pages.title: APEX Camcorder Teardown
pages.section: top bar, booking slate and START A PROJECT

name: Lift Rail
summary: An elevator panel sits in its own side gutter: a lit floor display counts down as you read, a fine shaft line fills, and round brushed-metal keys fly you to any floor; on small screens each section's floor tag opens the same panel.

name: OSD Menu
summary: The menu is a camcorder's on-screen display: pressing the rubber MENU key switches it on like an old monitor, a blinking cursor arrow moves through the sections with the pointer or arrow keys, and a tape counter ticks as you scroll.

name: Status Lanes
summary: A roadmap shown as a film-editor timeline with a draggable playhead above three lanes (done, being built, next); the playhead moves as you scroll, and tapping a row jumps to it.

name: Film Strip Steps
summary: Steps sit in film frames with sprocket edges; a light line runs along the strip as you scroll and each frame's number lights up as it passes, with corner brackets on hover.

name: Plug Map
summary: Chrome nodes wired into a central hub, with light pulsing along the live connection and dotted lines for the ones still to come.

name: Cassette Cards
summary: Offer cards are smoked-glass tape cassettes; pointing at one lifts and tilts it, the reels spin and the tape winds from one reel to the other.

pages.title: APEX Camcorder Teardown
pages.section: what you get (three cassettes + the long START A PROJECT cassette)

name: Model Ring
summary: A ring of fine ticks, one per item, split into two tones by type; it turns slowly, lights up tick by tick as you scroll, and shows the total in its centre.

name: Chrome Residents
summary: Each helper working for you is a small chrome figure standing in its project's glass room; its visor and ring glow by mood (white while it works, a bright glint and a soft sonar beacon when it needs you, coral when it is stuck, a check when it is done), and it turns to face you when you point at it.

name: Chrome Sweep
summary: Headings are polished platinum and a band of light sweeps across them once as they arrive; the words are always fully visible.

name: Curtain Letters
summary: The menu drops like a theatre curtain led by a thin line of colour, and each link rises letter by letter in a wave; pointing at a link lifts it and writes its name huge in the background.

name: Split Preview
summary: The menu opens as two halves sliding in from opposite edges: links on one side, and on the other a live miniature of the section you point at, which wipes in as you move down the list.

name: Ticker Nav
summary: The section links run past in a slow, endless ticker across the header; it eases to a stop under the pointer, can be dragged and flung, glides to whichever link you tab to, and marks the section you are reading.

name: Thumb Arc
summary: A glowing corner button fans the main actions (call, text, quote, check your area) out along a curved sweep; on a phone you can press, slide your thumb onto one and let go.

name: Chapter Roll
summary: The header always names the chapter you are reading; as you pass into the next one the name rolls over like a counter, a fine line fills through the chapter, and tapping the name drops a chapter list.

name: Rising Tide
summary: Pointing at the button fills it with colour from the bottom like rising liquid; the wavy surface sloshes toward the pointer and drains away when you leave.

name: Letter Roll
summary: Pointing at a button or link makes every letter roll over to an italic twin in a quick wave that starts from the side you came in from, while the arrow slides through.

name: Edge Light
summary: One soft light follows the pointer across a group of glass cards, catching the edges of every card it passes near, not just the one underneath.

name: Lead Trail
summary: Moving the pointer across the section leaves a trail of small sample-lead cards that pop up where you pass and drift away, so visitors literally see leads following them.

name: Plucked String
summary: Text links sit on a fine line that behaves like a guitar string: it bends toward the pointer as you cross it, then snaps back and quivers before settling.

name: Morph Field
summary: Form fields rest as quiet underlines; when you click one, the line grows out from where you clicked and swells into a softly glowing frame, the label lifts away, and a tick draws in once the answer looks right.

pages.title: APEX Camcorder Teardown
pages.section: hero booking slate and START A PROJECT form

name: Quote Stepper
summary: A short quote form that asks one plain question at a time: answers slide past like cards, a thread of light joins the step dots as you go, and the last step plays back your answers.

name: Submit Morph
summary: Pressing send shrinks the button into a spinning ring, which turns into a tick and then blooms open from that spot into the thank-you card.

name: Sentence Check
summary: The area checker is written as a sentence with blanks to fill in, "I run a ___ business and want leads in ___"; the blanks shimmer until filled, suggest business types as you type, and the answer unfolds underneath.

name: Flipbook Scrub
summary: A held frame plays a sequence of pictures like a flipbook as you scroll, forward and back, while short captions change beside it.

name: Fan Deck
summary: A neat stack of cards fans out into a hand as you scroll, then each card in turn rises out of the fan to be read.

name: Frame Tunnel
summary: Scrolling carries you forward through a corridor of picture frames, each one holding a step, until the last frame becomes the call to action.

name: Counter Columns
summary: Three columns of tiles slide in opposite directions as you scroll past, around a calm headline plate in the middle.

name: Grid Bloom
summary: A grid of tiles holds on screen while the middle tile grows to fill the view and the others drift away, revealing a full-screen message.

name: Orbit Caption
summary: A line of text circles a round button like a seal; it turns faster when you scroll, reverses when you scroll back, and slows when you point at it.

name: Throttle Marquee
summary: Giant lines of words glide sideways; scrolling speeds them up and flips their direction, and the outlined line fills in as it races.

name: Tide Fill
summary: A headline starts as an outline and fills from the bottom like rising water as you scroll, with a gentle wave at the waterline that lifts where you point.

name: Scatter Assemble
summary: The letters of a headline start scattered and tumbling, then fly together into place as it scrolls up the screen, and shy away from the pointer.

name: Satin Folds
summary: Soft folds of dark satin ripple slowly behind the page, catching a sheen of light that follows the pointer and shifts as you scroll.

name: Plexus Field
summary: A quiet field of points drifts and links up with fine lines; near the pointer they gather and their links light up, and a tap sends a ripple through them.

name: Halftone Light
summary: A fine grid of printed dots swells and shrinks under slow drifting lights, like a halftone photo of light, with a pool that follows the pointer.

name: Fluted Glass
summary: Soft lights move behind a wall of ribbed glass that bends them into stripes; moving the pointer sends ripples across the ribs.

name: Venetian Wipe
summary: The next section opens like venetian blinds: slats in the colour of the section above tilt shut into thin lines one after another as it scrolls in.

name: Bento Unfold
summary: A bento grid arrives as one neat pile in the centre, then deals itself out tile by tile into place with a little spring, and each tile glows where you point.

name: Panel Accordion
summary: A row of tall slim panels where the one you point at, tap or tab to slides open wide to show its details while the others fold into labelled spines.

name: Torn Stub
summary: A glass ticket with a dotted tear line; pointing at it lifts the stub, and clicking tears it away and back.

name: Shard Corners
summary: A glass bar with two cut corners; on hover the cut pieces break off as small shards and float beside it.

name: Dog-Ear
summary: A glass card with a folded-down corner that peels back further when you point at it and flattens when pressed.

name: Riding Tab
summary: A glass capsule with a small phone tab on top that slides along the edge to follow your pointer.

name: Convex Lens
summary: A lens-shaped glass button; a bright spot follows your pointer like light through a lens, and the label swells as if magnified.

name: Hex Bloom
summary: A hexagon of glass that buds small glass cells off its edges like a honeycomb when you point at it.

name: Shield Scan
summary: A glass shield; a line of light scans down it and a check mark draws itself when you point at it.

name: Twin Pane
summary: Two offset sheets of glass, one behind the other, that slide apart with your pointer and clap together when pressed.

name: Chrome Bezel
summary: Glass set in a polished chrome ring with two tiny screws; the chrome reflection turns toward your pointer.

name: Liquid Stretch
summary: A pill of liquid glass that stretches out toward your pointer as it gets close, then wobbles back.

name: Prism Edge
summary: A cut-gem bar of glass with facets; on hover, light splits into soft colour at its point and the label splits slightly.

name: Segment Run
summary: A pill split into four glass segments that light up in a running sequence and close their gaps when you point at it.

name: Orbit Dot
summary: A glass pill with one glowing dot circling its edge; pointing at it makes the dot race round with a short trail.

name: Chrome Float
summary: A glass button with a real 3D chrome map pin floating off its corner; it tilts with your pointer and rises on hover.

name: Split Line
summary: Glass cut in half through the middle of the label; on hover the two halves shear apart around a glowing seam.

name: Glass Ripple
summary: A pebble-shaped glass button; pressing it sends rings of light rippling out from your finger.

name: Clear Spot
summary: Heavily frosted glass that clears in a circle wherever you point, and clears completely when you press.

name: Thick Glass
summary: A thick slab of glass that bends the background at its edges; the bend deepens and shifts as you move over it.

name: Jelly Press
summary: A squircle of glass that squashes like jelly where you press it and wobbles back into shape.

name: Fill Submit
summary: A submit button whose glass fills with colour from left to right as it sends, with a percentage, then confirms.

name: Glass Switch
summary: A glass on/off switch with a bead of glass that slides and stretches between off and on.

name: Slide Select
summary: A glass segmented control; a liquid bubble slides and stretches to the option you choose.

name: Glass Orb
summary: Round icon-only glass orbs; the highlight and icon shift like a marble catching light as you move over them.

name: Magnet Pull
summary: A large slanted glass button that is pulled toward your pointer like a magnet, with a halo that grows as you near it.

name: Leaf Turn
summary: A leaf-shaped glass button whose round and sharp corners swap places when you point at it.

name: Focus Frame
summary: Glass framed by camera-style corner marks that hunt at rest, lock on when you point, and flash when you click.

name: Chevron Push
summary: An arrow-shaped glass sign; on hover, echo chevrons stream out of its point, urging you forward.

name: Glass Slab
summary: A thick block of glass whose edge thickness shows and shifts as it tilts toward your pointer; pressing pushes it in.

name: Rolling Puck
summary: A glass capsule with a round glass puck that rolls out along a little bridge when you point at it.

name: Glass Blinds
summary: Glass made of slats like window blinds; they swing shut in a wave from your pointer and flip when you click.

name: Ticket Stub
summary: A sample lead shown as a see-through glass ticket; tearing off the stub reveals the customer’s number.

name: Chamfer Plate
summary: A pricing card cut like a machined glass plate, whose edge lights up from behind wherever you point.

name: Dog-Ear Chrome
summary: An industry card with a folded glass corner and a real chrome icon floating above it that turns toward you.

name: Crest Shield
summary: A glass shield inside a chrome bezel whose reflections slowly turn; the seal glows from behind on hover.

name: Honeycomb Cell
summary: A hexagon of dotted glass that holds one figure; its inner outline turns to follow the pointer.

name: Territory Loupe
summary: A thick round glass lens over a small map of your area, with a loupe that magnifies wherever you point.

name: Double Pane
summary: A process step printed on two offset sheets of glass that slide apart, with light glowing in the gap.

name: Bezel Plaque
summary: Contact details behind clear glass set in a brushed-steel frame, with screws that turn when you point.

name: Liquid Glass
summary: A video card shaped like a drop of liquid glass that slowly rolls and breathes, with beads that follow you.

name: Prism Facets
summary: A feature card cut like a crystal whose facets catch the light as you move and split it into a soft spectrum.

name: Etched Bubble
summary: A speech-bubble of frosted glass with a large quotation mark etched into it that lights up from behind.

name: Lanyard Badge
summary: A glass staff badge hanging from a lanyard that swings when you brush it and slides up a short bio.

name: Lead File
summary: A sample lead kept in a stitched glass folder with a tab; opening it flips the folder to show the details.

name: Lead Receipt
summary: A sample lead printed on a torn, perforated glass receipt, with a thin laser scanning its barcode.

name: Slat Stack
summary: A list of trades on separate slanted slats of glass; the one you point at slides out and lights up.

name: Orbit Capsule
summary: A glass capsule showing that your area is open, with a small glass bead circling it on a tilted orbit.

name: Split Shard
summary: A glass card split along a slanted line into “shared” and “yours only”; the halves part and light pours through.

name: Squircle Stack
summary: Three stacked rounded-square sheets of glass that fan apart in depth, with a sample text alert sliding in on top.

name: Glass Slab
summary: A thick slab of glass like a member card: you see its edge as it tilts, and it turns over to show the back.

name: Fan Fold
summary: Three steps printed on a zig-zag folded strip of glass, like a paper fan, that flattens out when you open it.

name: Postmark Stamp
summary: A new-lead notice on a perforated glass postage stamp; pointing at it slams a postmark down onto the glass.

name: Bevel Diamond
summary: A diamond of bevelled glass, lit like an antique mirror, that turns over to explain what “yours only” means.

name: Bite Notch
summary: A pay-per-lead price card with a round bite taken out of one corner, where a glass button sits and follows you.

name: Fog Wipe
summary: A fogged-up shop window: wipe the glass with your pointer or finger to read the sample leads behind it.

name: Pennant Banner
summary: A swallow-tail banner of glass hung from a chrome rod, its folds catching light as if moved by a breeze.

name: Half-Moon Gauge
summary: A half-moon of instrument glass with engraved ticks and a chrome needle that settles on a sample reading.

name: Fanned Deck
summary: Three glass trade cards held like a hand of cards that fan out when you point and deal to the front one by one.

name: Luggage Tag
summary: A glass luggage tag on a cord, labelled with where your leads are delivered; flip it to see the route.

name: Viewfinder
summary: A video card framed like a camera viewfinder, with a focus box that follows you and light leaking round its edges.

name: Hinged Doors
summary: Two glass doors on chrome hinges that swing open to reveal a short call-back request form inside.

name: Camcorder Teardown
summary: As you scroll, a shoulder camcorder comes apart into hundreds of floating parts, holds so you can read seven labelled parts, then eases back together at an even pace with a soft glint as the last parts click home, dives down the lens and opens onto the next section. Scrolling up plays it all backwards.

name: Viewfinder Menu
summary: The menu turns the whole screen into a camera viewfinder: corner brackets fly in from the edges, the sections are huge chrome lines, an autofocus box glides to the one you point at or arrow to, and a playback monitor fast-forwards or rewinds real footage to that section.

name: Notch Morph
summary: A small black chrome pill at the top of the screen shows one light per helper; when one needs you (or you rest the pointer on it) it springs open into a glass card with the question and APPROVE / DENY / JUMP, then folds back into the pill.

name: Clapper Slate
summary: The sign-up form is a film production slate with its clapper sticks hovering open; pointing at send lowers them a little, and sending claps them shut with a soft flash and the slate reads "THAT'S A TAKE." with your details.

pages.title: APEX Camcorder Teardown
pages.section: hero booking form and START A PROJECT

name: Glass Watermark
summary: A giant, see-through wordmark with a fine silver edge sits in the footer so the moving background shows straight through the letters; as you scroll in, the letters rise from below and settle into place from the centre out, and sink back if you scroll up.

name: Blacklight Relic
summary: A matte-black machined medallion turns slowly in the dark, and wherever your light lands its edges glow cold and hidden markings appear like invisible ink: a serial number, the brand mark, fine engraved lines, your own mark and the structure inside it.

name: Caustic Glass
summary: Smoked glass panes float above a dark floor and the light passing through them throws shimmering, water-like nets of light onto the floor below, drifting as the glass sways and swinging wherever you move the light.

name: Two-Piece Glass
summary: A thick smoked-glass card has a button-shaped hole cut through it, and the button is its own slab of glass that lifts out toward you when you point at it, then drops back into the hole with a click when pressed.

name: Living Condensation
summary: The section sits behind fogged glass covered in water beads; your pointer or finger wipes it clear, drops gather and run down leaving clear streaks, a short word is written into the fog on arrival, and the fog slowly breathes back.

name: Molten Numerals
summary: Numbers made of liquid chrome: when a value changes, the old digits melt into mercury droplets that run underneath and climb back up into the new number, with thin silver light arcs circling behind.

name: Link Swarm
summary: A menu where thousands of fine specks of light hold a shape, and pointing at or tapping each link makes the swarm stream across and rebuild itself as that link's picture.

name: Mercury Bead
summary: A sealed smoked-glass button holds one bead of liquid chrome that rolls toward your pointer, and when pressed it bursts into droplets that race round the rim and pull back together under the words.

name: Crown Set
summary: A sapphire-glass button made like a watch, with a sweeping seconds hand and a chrome crown that winds when you point at it and clicks out when you press.

name: Masthead Flip
summary: Press CUSTOMIZE and the top bar flips over like a split-flap board to show the editing keys (hidden, add, panels, colours, reset); press DONE and it flips back to the greeting and the clock.

name: Edit Wobble
summary: In edit mode every tile lifts a little and gently rocks, each on its own beat, so it is obvious the board can be rearranged; pointing at a tile or tabbing to it holds it still.

pages.title: APEX COMMAND · CUSTOMIZE
pages.section: LAUNCH tiles and WEB rail in edit mode

name: Lift And Place
summary: Grab a tile and it lifts off the glass with a soft shadow and follows your hand while the other tiles slide aside to make room; let go and it springs into its new spot. Dropping it on the favourites row stars it.

pages.title: APEX COMMAND · CUSTOMIZE
pages.section: LAUNCH tiles and WEB rail in edit mode

name: Metal Wipe
summary: Pick a new colour and the new metal sweeps across the whole board on a soft diagonal edge, recolouring the moving chrome ground, the glass rims, the lettering, the keys and the 3D icons in one pass.

name: Reflow Glide
summary: Take a panel off the board and it fades away while the rest glide into their new places and grow to fill the space, so the board always looks composed with no empty holes.

name: Metal Coins
summary: Each colour choice is shown as a real 3D coin struck in that colour's own metal, turning slowly beside its name, so you see the actual finish before you pick it.
